description: Generate QR codes for links, text, messages, and Wi-Fi networks.

capabilities: Generate QR codes for links, text, and messages
Generate Wi-Fi network join QR codes
defaultPrompt: Make a QR code for sweetcrumbbakery.com
Create a Wi-Fi QR code for my guest network
Generate a QR code with my phone number
interface.longDescription: Create scannable QR codes for any link, text, or message in seconds. Also generates Wi-Fi QR codes so guests can join your network by scanning instead of typing a password. Handy for menus, event flyers, business cards, and sharing links on the go.

review.commerce_description: This app is free and does not sell products or process payments. Any future paid offering would use an external checkout on the developer's own website.

name: qr-generator
